workflow_runs.display_title: fix: prevent signal goroutine deadlock on shutdown

head_commit.message:
fix: prevent signal goroutine deadlock on shutdown

The handleSignals goroutine sent on the unbuffered p.msgs channel
without checking p.ctx.Done(). When a signal raced the event loop's
shutdown, the send blocked forever: the deferred close(ch) never ran,
and shutdown() blocked waiting for the handler to finish, leaving the
terminal unrestored.

Add a select on p.ctx.Done() alongside the send so the goroutine
exits cleanly when the program is shutting down.
